(basketball)|Fenerbahçe]] of the Turkish [[Basketbol Süper Ligi]] (BSL) and the [[EuroLeague]]. He played one season in the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA) with the [[Chicago Bulls]]. He won the Turkish slam dunk contest twice, during 2018 and 2020 [[Turkish Basketball Super League All-Star Game|Basketbol Süper Ligi All-Star Weekend]].{{cite web|title=All-Star Smaç Yarışmasında Şampiyon Onuralp Bitim!|url=https://www.eurohoops.net/tr/tbl-tr/600165/star-smac-yarismasinda-sampiyon-onuralp-bitim/|website=Eurohoops.net|date=21 January 2018|access-date=3 June 2019|language=tr}}{{cite web|title=ING Smaç Yarışmasının Şampiyonu Onuralp Bitim Oldu!|url=https://basketservisi.com/2020/01/19/ing-smac-yarismasinin-sampiyonu-onuralp-bitim-oldu/|website=Eurohoops.net|date=19 January 2020|access-date=20 January 2020|language=tr}} ==Professional career== ===Anadolu Efes (2017–2019)=== He started his career with [[Anadolu Efes S.K.|Anadolu Efes]] and signed a dual license contract also with [[İstanbul Teknik Üniversitesi B.K.|İTÜ BK]] for the 2017–2018 season. Thus, he played for both teams during the season. On 8 October 2017, he made his [[Basketbol Süper Ligi|Basketball Super League]] debut against [[Karşıyaka Basket|Karşıyaka]] and on 25 October 2017, he made his [[EuroLeague]] debut against [[Fenerbahçe S.K. (basketball)|Fenerbahçe]]. ===Karşıyaka (2019–2021)=== On 28 July 2019, Bitim signed a two-year contract with [[Karşıyaka Basket|Pınar Karşıyaka]].{{cite web|title=Onuralp Bitim Pınar Karşıyaka'da|url=https://kskbasketbol.net/2019/07/28/onuralp-bitim-pinar-karsiyakada/|website=KSKBasketbol.net|date=28 July 2019|access-date=19 August 2023|language=tr|archive-date=19 September 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210919023457/https://kskbasketbol.net/2019/07/28/onuralp-bitim-pinar-karsiyakada/|url-status=dead}} On May 11, 2020, while [[Karşıyaka Basket|Karşıyaka]] was in second place in the [[Basketbol Süper Ligi|Turkish League]] with 20 wins, the league was postponed due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic]] and it was announced that the league would not continue and there would be no champion in the league.{{cite web|title=Türkiye Basketbol Federasyonundan Bilgilendirme |url=https://www.tbf.org.tr/haber/bilgilendirme-11052020 |website=tbf.org.tr |date=14 May 2020 |language=tr}} ===Bursaspor (2021–2023)=== On 7 June 2021, Bitim signed a two-year contract with [[Bursaspor Basketbol|Frutti Extra Bursaspor]].{{cite web|title=Onuralp Bitim Frutti Extra Bursaspor'da|url=https://www.bursaspor.org.tr/haber/onuralp-bitim-frutti-extra-bursaspor-da/2821|website=Bursaspor.org.tr|date=7 June 2021|access-date=19 August 2023|language=tr}} After having a successful season with Bursaspor and reaching the EuroCup final, on 9 May 2022, Bitim extended his contract with the club for two more seasons.{{cite web|title=Onuralp Bitim ile 2 Yıl Daha!|url=https://www.bursaspor.org.tr/haber/onuralp-bitim-ile-2-yil-daha/5488|website=Bursaspor.org.tr|date=9 May 2022|access-date=19 August 2023|language=tr}} ===Chicago Bulls / Windy City Bulls (2023–2024)=== On 25 July 2023, Bitim signed a [[two-way contract]] with the [[Chicago Bulls]]{{cite web|title=Bulls sign Onuralp Bitim to Two-Way Contract|url=https://www.nba.com/bulls/news/bulls-sign-onuralp-bitim-to-two-way-contract|website=NBA.com|date=25 July 2023|access-date=25 July 2023}} and on 24 February 2024, he signed a standard contract.{{cite web|title=Bulls convert Bitim to standard NBA contract|url=https://www.nba.com/bulls/news/bulls-convert-bitim-to-standard-nba-contract|website=NBA.com|date=24 February 2024|access-date=24 February 2024}} Bitim appeared in 23 games for Chicago in his rookie campaign, averaging 3.5 points, 1.4 rebounds, and 0.6 assists. On 16 April 2024, it was announced that Bitim had suffered a [[retinal detachment|detached retina]] in his right eye, and would undergo season–ending surgery.{{Cite web|title=Onuralp Bitim suffers detached retina, out for postseason|url=https://m.basketnews.com/news-204810-onuralp-bitim-suffers-detached-retina-out-for-postseason.html|access-date=April 23, 2024|website=basketnews.com|language=en}} On 17 October 2024, Bitim was waived by the Bulls.{{cite tweet|author=Chicago Bulls|title=Transactions: We have waived Onuralp Bitim & Kenneth Lofton Jr. Thank you for your hard work and best of luck.|number=1846929181994627210|user=chicagobulls|date=17 October 2024|access-date=19 October 2024}} ===Fenerbahçe (2024–present)=== [[File:Onuralp Bitim 17 Fenerbahçe Basketbol TBSL 20260208 (2) (cropped).jpg|thumb|260px|]] On 8 November 2024, Bitim signed a contract with Istanbul powerhouse [[Fenerbahçe S.K. (basketball)|Fenerbahçe Beko]] until the end of the 2027–2028 season.{{cite web|title=Onuralp Bitim Fenerbahçe Beko'da|url=https://fenerbahce.org/haberler/basketbol-erkek/2024/11/onuralp-bitim-fenerbahce-beko-da|website=Fenerbahçe.org|date=8 November 2024|access-date=11 November 2024|language=tr}} On 24 September 2025, he made his debut with the team in the [[2025 Turkish Basketball Presidential Cup|2025]] [[Turkish Basketball Presidential Cup|Turkish Presidential Cup]] [[2025 Turkish Basketball Presidential Cup#Final|Final]] against [[Beşiktaş J.K. (men's basketball)|Beşiktaş Gain]], Bitim helped to Fenerbahçe to win the cup (85-83) with 8 points, 2 rebounds and 2 assists.{{cite web|title=Cumhurbaşkanlığı Kupası’nda Zafer Fenerbahçe Beko’nun |url=https://fenerbahce.org/haberler/basketbol-erkek/2025/9/cumhurbaskanligi-kupasi-nda-zafer-fenerbahce-beko-nun/ |website=|publisher=[[Fenerbahçe S.K. (basketball)|Fenerbahçe Beko]]. |date=September 24, 2025 |access-date=September 25, 2025 |language=Tr}} On 1 October 2025, he made his [[EuroLeague]] debut with the team against [[Paris Basketball]] in a 96-77 victory.{{Cite web |date=2025-10-01 |title=Son Şampiyon Fenerbahçe Beko, EuroLeague’e galibiyetle başladı |url=https://fenerbahce.org/haberler/basketbol-erkek/2025/9/son-sampiyon-fenerbahce-beko-euroleague-e-galibiyetle-basladi |access-date=2025-10-02 |website=Fenerbahce.org |language=tr}} ====Loan to Bayern Munich (2024–2025)==== [[File:2025-01-05 ALBA Berlin gegen FC Bayern München (Basketball-Bundesliga 2024-25) by Sandro Halank–041.jpg|thumb|230px]] He was loaned by [[Fenerbahçe S.K. (basketball)|Fenerbahçe Beko]] to [[FC Bayern Munich (basketball)|Bayern Munich]] until the end of 2024–2025 season.{{cite web|title=Bayern Basketbol Takımı, forvet Onuralp Bitim'i kiraladı|url=https://fcbayern.com/basketball/en/news/2024-25/11/onuralp-bitim-turkish|website=FCBayern.com|date=8 November 2024|access-date=11 November 2024|language=tr}} ==International== Bitim represented the [[Turkey men's national basketball team|Turkish national team]] at the [[2023 FIBA Basketball World Cup qualification (Europe)|2023 FIBA World Cup]] qualification.{{cite news|title= Onuralp Bitim A Milli Takımda!|url=https://www.bursaspor.org.tr/haber/onuralp-bitim-a-milli-takimda/4837|website=Bursaspor.org.tr|date=14 February 2022|access-date=11 November 2024|language=tr}} ==Personal life== He is a longtime fan of [[Fenerbahçe S.K. (football)|Fenerbahçe]] since his childhood,{{cite news |title= Onuralp Bitim: "Fenerbahçe Hayattaki İlk Aşkımdı, Burada Olmak Çok Anlamlı" |url=https://www.eurohoops.net/tr/euroleague-tr/1739867/onuralp-bitim-fenerbahce-hayattaki-ilk-askimdi-burada-olmak-cok-anlamli/ |website=eurohoops.net |date=8 November 2024 |language=tr}} because of his family; his father Mustafa Kemal Bitim{{cite web|title=Baba-oğul şampiyonlar: Mustafa Kemal Bitim & Onuralp Bitim|url=https://www.fanatik.com.tr/basketbol/baba-ogul-sampiyonlar-mustafa-kemal-bitim-onuralp-bitim-2072452|website=Fanatik.com.tr|date=24 June 2019|access-date=19 August 2023|language=tr}} played for [[Fenerbahçe S.K. (basketball)|Fenerbahçe Men's Basketball Team]] in [[2001–02 Turkish Basketball League|2001–2002]]{{cite news |title= Mustafa Kemal Bitim Profile at tblstat.net |url=https://bsl.tblstat.net/player/271 |website=TBLstat.net |accessdate=10 November 2024 |language=tr}} season and his mother Hilal Ertunalı played 8 seasons (between 1990–1998) for [[Fenerbahçe S.K. (women's basketball)|Fenerbahçe Women's Basketball Team]].{{cite web|title=Antalya basketbolunda nöbet değişikliği Antalya Basketbol İl Temsilciliğine eski milli basketbolcu Hilal Ertunalı getirildi|url=https://www.haberturk.com/antalya-haberleri/96686137-antalya-basketbolunda-nobet-degisikligiantalya-basketbol-il-temsilciligine-eski-milli|website=Haberturk.com|date=24 April 2022|access-date=19 August 2023|language=tr}} On 8 November 2024, Bitim said in the 40+ program he attended on [[Fenerbahçe TV]] that he has been a Fenerbahçe fan since his childhood and that he owns many Fenerbahçe jerseys, and his favorite jersey is the 100th anniversary [[Roberto Carlos]] jersey.{{cite news|title=Onuralp Bitim, Fenerbahçe Televizyonu'nda yayınlanan 40+ programına konuk oldu |url=https://fenerbahce.org/haberler/basketbol-erkek/2024/11/onuralp-bitim-fenerbahce-televizyonu-nda-yayinlanan-40-programina-konuk-oldu |website=Fenerbahçe SK |date=8 November 2024 |access-date=11 November 2024 |language=tr}} ==Career statistics== {{NBA player statistics legend}} ===NBA=== {{NBA player statistics start}} |- | style="text-align:left;"| {{nbay|2023}} | style="text-align:left;"| {{flagicon|USA|size=20px}} [[2023–24 Chicago Bulls season|Chicago Bulls]] | 23 || 1 || 11.7 || .381 || .273 || .800 || 1.4 || .6 || .1 || .1 || 3.5 |- class="sortbottom" | style="text-align:center;" colspan="2"| '''Career''' | 23 || 1 || 11.7 || .381 || .273 || .800 || 1.4 || .6 || .1 || .1 || 3.5 {{S-end}} ===NBA G League=== {{NBA player statistics start}} |- | style="text-align:left;"| [[2023–24 NBA G League season|2023–24]] | style="text-align:left;"| {{flagicon|USA|size=20px}} [[Windy City Bulls]] | 22 || ?
